Variants.Content: Old feud on one side of The Stormlands are shaped by the storms of Shipbreaker Bay, rainforests, outback farmsteads, and the Dornish Marches. The lords and knights here are accustomed to attach great importance to hardness, directness and the ability to guard their city gates; coastal residents must respect the weather, while border residents remember that the mountain roads are different. The Stormlands support farmland and cavalry, but are also roughened by broken roads, shipwrecks, and border conflicts. Outsiders often only see Baratheon's deer flags; locals are more concerned with the rainy season, harvests, roofs and who will help rebuild after storms.

Entry Stormlands Culture Stormlands Society: The Stormlands are shaped by the storms of Shipbreaker Bay, rainforests, outback farmsteads, and the Dornish Marches. The lords and knights here are accustomed to attach great importance to hardness, directness and the ability to guard their city gates; coastal residents must respect the weather, while border residents remember that the mountain roads are different. They care about water sources, roads, customs and garrison, and know that behind the place names there is often a food road that can keep the castle alive.

Stones, trees, rivers or mountain passes can become places of livelihood, and may also be endowed with sanctity, taboos and ancestral memories, so they cannot be measured in terms of money alone.
